description: Conformance gates run by tools/run_gates.py. 'run' placeholders: {python}, {bend}, {raylib}. 'minutes' is an approximate hosted-runner duration used only to balance shards. Diagnostic entries record evidence for open gaps and never count as parity.

Ogg Vorbis codebooks (stb_vorbis: compute_codewords, compute_sorted_huffman, compute_accelerated_huffman, float32_unpack, ilog, bit_reverse, lookup1_values) against stb_vorbis.c's own functions: complete and incomplete trees of up to 3000 symbols, symbols without a code, codes of every length to 31, sparse codebooks and not, symbols past the accelerated table's shorts, lengths that are no tree (refused by both), and lookup1_values wherever its float estimate is sure (the pairs that hang on the C library's last bits or on an undefined conversion are refused)

Ogg data as stb_vorbis reads it (start_page, start_packet, maybe_start_packet, next_segment, get8_packet_raw, get8_packet, get32_packet, flush_packet, get_bits, get8, get32, getn, skip) against stb_vorbis.c's own functions, call by call: everything the reader keeps after each of 781,620 calls of six scripts over raylib's target.ogg, its cuts and damaged copies, and built pages (packets over pages with and without the flag, a page without segments, a full table, empty packets, unknown positions, data that ends in a segment or a table, bytes between pages)

The Vorbis setup (stb_vorbis start_decoder: the identification header, the comment header, and the setup header's codebooks with their lookups, time domain transfers, floors with their sorted points and neighbours, residues, mappings and modes) against stb_vorbis.c's own start_decoder: whether it succeeds, its error code, the stage it came to and everything it had read whole by then; raylib's target.ogg, 100 damaged copies and 148 built streams; the files stb_vorbis answers with what a port cannot give are refused (lookup1_values unsure or undefined, entries * dimensions past the ints, an allocation over 16 MiB, a codebook over 2^19 entries, a sixteenth submap)
